sqlMap.select: SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME FROM ROLES ORDER BY ROLE_NAME
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME FROM ROLES WHERE ROLE_ID = #roleId#

SELECT R.ROLE_ID, R.ROLE_NAME, P.PERMISSION_ID, P.PERMISSION_NAME FROM ROLES R LEFT JOIN ROLE_PERMISSIONS RP ON R.ROLE_ID = RP.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN PERMISSIONS P ON RP.PERMISSION_ID = P.PERMISSION_ID WHERE R.ROLE_ID = #roleId#

SELECT DISTINCT R.ROLE_ID, R.ROLE_NAME FROM ROLES R INNER JOIN ROLE_PERMISSIONS RP ON R.ROLE_ID = RP.ROLE_ID INNER JOIN PERMISSIONS P ON RP.PERMISSION_ID = P.PERMISSION_ID WHERE P.PERMISSION_NAME IN
#permissionNames[]#
